 Maricha (Black pepper) (Piper nigrum) – 48 g

 Mulaka Kshara – Radish – Raphanus sativus – 96 g

 Grind all the above given ingredients into fine powder and then it is triturated using lemon juice and finally converted to tablets form. Keep it in cool dry place.

fullContent:
Gandhak Vati 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Agnimandya Rogadhikara 56 – 62 
 Introduction 
 Gandhak Vati is an herbal formulation in tablet form that keeps the Vata and Kapha Doshas in balance and improves the Pitta. One of the best Ayurvedic treatment for indigestion. It is combination of herbal and mineral ingredients. Hence should only be taken strictly under medical supervision. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada (Purified and processed Mercury) – 24 g 
 Gandhaka (Purified and processed Sulphur) – 48 g 
 Shunti (Ginger) (Zingiber officinalis) –Rhizome – 48 g 
 Lavanga (Clove) (Syzigium aromaticum) – 48 g 
 Maricha (Black pepper) (Piper nigrum) – 48 g 
 Saindhava (Rock Salt) – 144 g 
 Suvarchala Lavana (Sochal salt) – 144 g 
 Chanaka (Chick pea) – Cicer arietinuin Linn – 96 g 
 Mulaka Kshara – Radish – Raphanus sativus – 96 g 
 Nimbuka swarasa – Lemon juice extract – quantity sufficient. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Grind all the above given ingredients into fine powder and then it is triturated using lemon juice and finally converted to tablets form. Keep it in cool dry place. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 1-2 tablets once or twice a day, before or after having meals or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Beneficial Ayurvedic treatment in case of indigestion and improves digestive power. 
 Improves anorexia, low appetite 
 Treats constipation and hyperacidity 
 Controls the mucus in stool 
 Provides relief from abdominal pain 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 As it comprises of heavy metal ingredients so better to avoid in pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 Its over-dose may results in minor burning sensation in abdomen. 
 Keep it away from children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
